introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. \n\nStep a big step backward with your right leg and lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the floor. Return and repeat with the other side.
name: BACKWARD LUNGE

tips.text: Take a big step backward.
Keep your legs at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your weight on your heels when pushing your body up.
Don't let your front knee go past your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To increase the difficulty, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
Your knees should not be sore.
This targets all your leg muscles.
It\'s a good leg exercise that won\'t hurt your knees.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce: Stand up with your arms at your sides. Cross your right leg behind your left leg. \n\nExtend both arms over your head, grasp your right palm with your left hand and pull it to your left side. Bend your upper body to your left side. Hold for a few seconds.
name: CROSS LEG SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a stretch on the right side of your upper body and outer thigh.
Inhale deeply as you lift your arms up and over your head.
Exhale as you bend to the left side, keeping your core engaged.

introduce: Stand up with your arms at your sides. Cross your left leg behind your right leg. \n\nExtend both arms over your head, grasp your left palm with your right hand and pull it to your right side. Bend your upper body to your right side. Hold for a few seconds.
name: CROSS LEG SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a stretch on the left side of your upper body and outer thigh.
Inhale deeply as you lift your arms up and over your head.
Exhale as you bend to the left side, keeping your core engaged.

introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your feet apart a little wider than shoulder-width, and your hips against the wall. \n\nBend your knees to make a 1/4 squat and then return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: QUARTER WALL SQUAT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Take a deep breath in as you're standing straight.
Exhale slowly when lowering yourself to engage your core.
Please keep your knees in line with your tiptoes.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly extend your left leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly extend your right leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce: Lie flat down on your back with your left leg straight on the ground, and your right leg bent with your right foot flat on the ground. \n\nTighten your left leg and lift it straight up until your thighs are parallel, then slowly lower it down.
name: STRAIGHT LEG RAISE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight and tight during the exercise.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce: Lie flat down on your back with your right leg straight on the ground, and your left leg bent with your left foot flat on the ground. \n\nTighten your right leg and Lift it straight up until your thighs are parallel, then slowly lower it down.
name: STRAIGHT LEG RAISE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight and tight during the exercise.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
